public.title: Undo / Redo Manager II
public.description: input {initial,operations}; initial is an integer. Set {value} changes only draft; commit adds a checkpoint only when draft differs from committed and clears redo only for an effective commit. Undo/redo first discard uncommitted draft then navigate checkpoint history, with boundary no-ops. Return {draft,committed} after each operation. At most 20 operations. This batch manager uses explicit commits instead of per-edit history. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Keep draft separate from committed state; only effective commits touch history, while navigation discards drafts. O(q) time and storage for scalar values. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
